extraction_notes: The supplied six-page PDF identifies AO3400-HXY as an N-channel enhancement-mode MOSFET; the exact job manufacturer identity is retained as HXY MOSFET and the PDF branding is HUAXUANYANG Electronics CO., LTD.
Figures 5, 7, and 10 contain usable output, transfer, and capacitance curves. Listed points are compact direct readings from the plotted traces and are not interpolated.

The output-characteristics figure does not state a temperature. The transfer figure provides separate 25 degC and 125 degC curves. The capacitance figure does not state a temperature; the tabulated capacitance conditions provide VDS = 15 V, VGS = 0 V, and f = 1 MHz at TA = 25 degC.
The electrical-characteristics table publishes typical and maximum RDS(ON) values at VGS = 2.5 V, 4.5 V, and 10 V; both values are transcribed for every published test-condition row.

The strict MOSFET schema has no fields for IDSS, IGSS, gFS, switching times, gate charge, thermal resistance, or absolute maximum ratings beyond the supported fields; those fields were not added outside schema.
